# 薩婆多毘尼毘婆沙

**ID:** T1440
**Volume:** T23
**Category:** 律部類
**Original Category:** 律部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 350–431
**Juans:** 9
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1440

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A nine-fascicle Chinese rendering of the Sanskrit *Sarvāstivāda-vinaya-vibhāṣā* — a commentary on the *Shísòng lǜ* ([KR6k0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0016)) preserving Indian Sarvāstivāda exegetical tradition. 薩婆多 *Sàpóduō* transliterates *sarvāstivāda*; 毘尼 *pínì* transliterates *vinaya*; 毘婆沙 *pípóshā* transliterates *vibhāṣā* (commentary). Translator and date unknown; the catalog tradition assigns it to "lost translation" (失譯), but the text's diction and translation conventions place it in the late-Eastern Jìn / early-Liú-Sòng period (late 4th to early 5th c.).

**Abstract**

The *Sàpóduō pínì pípóshā* is the principal **Sarvāstivāda Vinaya commentary** in the Chinese canon (parallel to the Dharmaguptaka *Pínì-mǔ jīng* [KR6k0044](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0044) and the Theravāda *Shànjiàn lǜ pípóshā* [KR6k0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0043)). The text systematically expounds the *bhikṣu-prātimokṣa* of the *Shísòng lǜ*, providing exegetical comment on the rule-formulations, with technical discussions of *karmavācanā* procedure, school identification, and inter-Vinaya comparison. It is one of the earliest examples of Indian *vinaya-vibhāṣā* exegetical literature preserved in Chinese, and a key witness for the early Sarvāstivāda exegetical tradition.
